summary: Ares Industrial Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose its monthly net asset value per share as of July 31, 2026, and the related September 1, 2026 transaction price. The filing describes the board-approved valuation procedures and engagement of Altus Group as independent valuation advisor. It provides NAV components and per-share values for share classes. This is a routine periodic NAV update for a non-traded REIT, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or corporate action is announced. The filing is informational and recurring, lacking any event qualifying under special-situations categories.
